## Publication Information

**Date:** 1864-1865

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (July 1864-April 1865)

**Notes:** Although this series of articles describes Germany and Switzerland as well as Italy, CMY referred to it as 'Italian letters' in an answer to a correspondent <i>MP</i> (March 1865) 336, which is why it seems likely to be the 'Italian letters' mentioned to Ann Carter Smith.
